Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films that cover a range of sub‑genres—from supernatural chills to psychological dread and gore‑heavy splatter:

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑genre / Notable Element |
|---|-------|------|-----------------------------|
| 1 | **Psycho** | 1960 | Psychological thriller; iconic shower scene |
| 2 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Haunted hotel, isolation, supernatural dread |
| 3 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | Demonic possession, intense religious themes |
| 4 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Family trauma, cosmic horror, unsettling atmosphere |
| 5 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social satire + horror; psychological thriller |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Silence‑based tension, creature horror |
| 7 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Daylight horror, folk cult rituals |
| 8 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Modern folklore, relentless stalker |
| 9 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological horror, grief metaphor |
|10 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑horror, twist on tropes |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Viral curse, supernatural horror |
|12 | **28 Days Later** | 2002 | Post‑apocalyptic zombie outbreak |
|13 | **The Texas Chainsaw Massacre** | 1974 | Gritty slasher, raw terror |
|14 | **Saw** | 2004 | Psychological torture, moral dilemmas |
|15 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Puritan horror, atmospheric dread |

Feel free to pick based on your preferred style—whether you’re after a slow‑burn psychological scare or a high‑octane slasher. Enjoy the chills!
